correctness.rationale: For d(1-16d) nonzero in an algebraically closed field k, completed (2,2) curve E is smooth genus one and has exactly four missing points O,T,R,-R. From local reciprocal charts and principal divisors div(u)=2O-R-(-R), div(u+1)=2T-R-(-R), div(v)=2R-O-T, div(v+1)=2(-R)-O-T, Abel–Jacobi gives H={O,R,2R,-R}=<R> of exact order four. Every automorphism of the affine open extends uniquely to E and permutes H; it is t_h alpha with h∈H and origin-preserving alpha stabilizing H. Such alpha sends R to ±R. Nontrivial origin autos fixing R cannot exist: in char≠2,3 origin autos have order 2,4,6 with unique involution inversion; odd-order 3 satisfies deg(1-alpha)=3, so cannot fix all four distinct elements of H. In char3 supersingular origin group dicyclic order12 yields the same order/degree obstruction. In char2 geometric order-four torsion forces ordinarity, with origin stabilizer {1,[-1]}. Thus |Aut(C_d)|<=8; coordinate flips and exchange generate 8 D8 maps. Invariant ring: A=u²+u, B=d/A, k[C] free over Laurent k[A,A^-1] with basis 1,u,v,uv; simultaneous flips fix exactly Laurent subring even in char2 (2u+1 and 2v+1 are nonzero), and exchange fixes k[A+d/A]=k[J]. Independent symbolic substitution checked three transformations and J, plus a direct four-point permutation closure of order 8. The finite checker does not establish the all-characteristic upper bound, which rests on torsion/classification.
